title: Zarr — statistics of what you draw
description: Zonal statistics over a pyramided Zarr: the shape you draw is measured in the month the layer is painting, with a single shared request.

list.label: zone
list.query:
-- El mapa publica lo que dibujas como WKT; TiTiler quiere GeoJSON.
-- OJO: en una consulta de VARIABLE el datasource NO entrecomilla solo (si lo
-- hace en las de panel), asi que las comillas van a mano. Y el ::VARCHAR no es
-- cosmetico: sin el, "unsupported Scan ... map[string]interface{}".
LOAD spatial;
SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_GeomFromText(
  coalesce(nullif('${area}', ''), 'POLYGON((-75 -12, -75 2, -50 2, -50 -12, -75 -12))')))::VARCHAR

list.name: mes
list.label: Month measured
list.query:
-- El mes que el mapa esta pintando. `mapTo` lo publica el propio panel al
-- mover la barra de tiempo, y el store responde a un entero, no a una fecha.
SELECT extract(month FROM coalesce(try_cast(nullif('${mapTo}', '') AS TIMESTAMPTZ),
                                   $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::INTEGER::VARCHAR

options.content:
# Statistics of what you draw, over a pyramided Zarr

Monthly mean temperature from CarbonPlan's climate demo. **Draw** a polygon with the map's tool and **drag the time bar**: the numbers measure that area in that month.

This store is written **for maps** — a six-level pyramid, 128×128 chunks, already in Web Mercator — and it shows in both halves:

| | Drawing a tile | Measuring an area |
|---|---|---|
| This store | 0.22–2.2 s, flat at every zoom | **1.0–1.5 s** |
| GPCP, no pyramid | 1.2–17.5 s, worse as you zoom out | 6.9–21.1 s |

The four panels on the right **share a single request**: the table makes it, and the two figures reuse it through the `-- Dashboard --` datasource. One more figure costs zero requests.

The chain is the same as ever: the map publishes the shape as WKT, a query variable turns it into GeoJSON with DuckDB, and Infinity sends it to `/zarr/statistics` with the same `sel` the layer uses.

**The map's clock is in charge** (`Time range sync: Slider writes variables`): on releasing the bar, the panel writes the window into `mapFrom`/`mapTo`, that recomputes the month, and the three panels refresh. In any other mode the variables are not published and the statistics stay pinned to the end of the dashboard's range.

panels.title: Monthly mean temperature · draw an area and drag the time bar

targets.rawSql:
-- Una fila por mes. El store es piramidado (`zarr_levels`), asi que cada zoom
-- pide su propio nivel; y su eje temporal no son fechas sino enteros 1..12 en
-- una dimension llamada `month`, de ahi `zarr_time_dim` y `zarr_time_label`.
SELECT
  make_timestamp(2020, m, 1, 0, 0, 0)::TIMESTAMPTZ AS time,
  'https://carbonplan-maps.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/v2/demo/4d/tavg-prec-month' AS zarr_url,
  'climate'   AS zarr_variable,
  6           AS zarr_levels,
  'band=tavg' AS zarr_sel,
  'month'     AS zarr_time_dim,
  m::TEXT     AS zarr_time_label
FROM generate_series(1, 12) t(m)
ORDER BY time
